asr.full_text: Hello, my name is Rajesh and I'm here to help you with all of your issues. Hey Rajesh we've been using your product for a few weeks now and today it crashed and we cannot launch it anymore. Okay sir thank you for letting me know. And what am I supposed to do now? What is the priority of the issue? What do you mean the priority, it's urgent. Priority from one to 10, but I mean the severity is very low and I can close the ticket now. And 10 means the severity is very high and I cannot close the ticket yet. It's 20. 20 meaning? Meaning it's a people are dying priority but are they dying instantly or slowly? Maybe what can we finally start talking about my problem? ok sir does the problem have a strategical impact on the business? it does, the program doesn't work I'm getting an error object reference not set to an instance of an object. Is that something on the screen sir? Where else could it be? Thank you sir. Our department is not responsible for screen issues. I will get you through to another team who will help you on that sir, ok? It is NOT screen issue. Thank can I do for you? Hi I'm getting an error object reference not set to an instance of an object. Yes the weather is nice and you? Yeah do you speak English? Yes I speak okay what is problem? object reference not set to an instance of an object f.. I don't understand anything sorry, can you repeat, please? is there someone around who actually speaks English and knows the product you sell? this software. We have plenty of solutions in our portfolio, but we do not support this one. It is company policy for our department. So please put me through to someone who knows the answer and is allowed to give it to me. Naja, please wait. Never in my life have I heard of such a complex issue, but as far as I know... Is this a fake British accent? Yeah, I'm sorry. I totally understand your problem and I know how to fix it. Finally, so what is the solution? Since you've been waiting a long time to get connected with the right person, instead of giving you a link to our knowledge base article, let me put you through to an engineer who will give you step-by-step instructions on the phone and make sure it works on your end, okay? Okay, that works. Hello, this is Rajesh. Hello sir, are you okay? I feel you're in pain, sir. How big is your pain from 1 to 5 billion?

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is framed as a comedic tech-support scenario involving software errors, ticket priority, unsupported software, and escalation for troubleshooting. The sketch branding and creator end card reinforce an entertainment or workplace-parody context, while the described interactions contain no viewer-facing purchase, investment, payment, credential, or deceptive-offer solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary subject is a produced IT-themed depiction of a support call, including software errors, support-team exchanges, and an end card identifying the IT PYTHON production. This supports general entertainment content rather than a scam mechanism.
